run_eval_ghn_predefined: run the eval_ghn script to evaluate a GHN checkpoint on predefined architectures for cifar10
run_eval_ghn_test_split: run the eval_ghn script to evaluate a GHN checkpoint on all test architectures for imagenet
run_eval_ghn_single_arch: run the eval_ghn script to evaluate a single architecture on the wide test split
review_GHN_load: review the GHN.load method to understand how checkpoints are loaded with debug and verbose options
review_infer: review the infer function to understand how top1 and top5 accuracy are computed during evaluation
